During an insert of data using CLP characters, they do not go through codepage conversion.
If operating system and database codepage both are UTF-8, but the data to be inserted is not Unicode, then data in the database might have incorrect codepoints (not-Unicode) and the above error will be a result during data retrieval.
answer_edits.after: DB2 CLP input may bypass code-page conversion when both the operating system and database are configured for UTF-8 but the input is not Unicode. This can store invalid code points in column comments. Reinsert the affected data using code-page conversion, setting the operating-system code page to match the input data encoding.
